notes: 1. Desktop icon horizontal spacing is noticeably tighter in B (the 7 icons span ~54% of viewport width vs ~63% in A). 2. All 7 desktop icons are redrawn in a crisp, saturated vector/cartoon style rather than A's muted retro pixel-art sprites, adding bright blue title bars (GemNotes, GemPaint, GemSweeper), a bright yellow pencil, an orange explosion burst on GemSweeper, and a pure-white Gemini Chat tile. 3. The Doom II Cacodemon icon is roughly twice as large and brightly colored in B compared to the tiny dark-red pixel sprite in A. 4. The taskbar Start button 'Gemini' wordmark is smaller, italicized, and inset with more gray padding (with the star over the final 'i'), whereas A uses taller, upright text filling the button height with a star breaking the top edge. 5. Icon interior details differ: My Gemtop lacks the colorful globe emblem on its monitor, GemSweeper uses colored digits instead of monochrome black, and GemNotes omits the small blue sparkle on the notepad.
